summary: Build board-level governance skills with ISO 37000, COSO ERM, and practical board tools. Train with confidence and apply it immediately.
lede: Corporate governance for boards and directors provides a practical system for guiding organizations, overseeing management, and connecting strategy, risk, ethics, and performance. This course helps you build the judgment and working practices needed to challenge assumptions, assess board effectiveness, and demonstrate credible oversight. Through guided exercises, you will create a board skills matrix, draft a board charter, shape a risk appetite statement, test committee oversight, and use dashboard-style reporting to track governance actions. You will also explore ESG reporting interfaces and digital board-pack practices while learning to turn findings into a board improvement roadmap for use in demanding, confidential, and information-limited environments.
audienceIntro: This advanced corporate governance for boards and directors course is built for professionals who influence board decisions, oversee assurance, and shape governance quality. It is most useful when you already sit close to the board or support it directly.
prerequisites: Participants should already work at board, board-committee, or senior governance level, or be preparing for a board appointment. A working understanding of financial statements, enterprise risk, and organizational structure is required. No legal qualification is required, but you should be comfortable reading board papers, committee reports, and governance policies. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational and applied level, with emphasis on boardroom deliverables rather than technical engineering.
